name: Generic Transaction Behaviour
description: Typology-agnostic transaction red flags applicable across all crime types. Covers rapid movement of funds, absent economic rationale, activity out of line with profile, dormant account reactivation, round amounts and third-party payments.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach (sector-specific guidance series, general principles)
FATF Recommendations, Recommendation 1 and Interpretive Note (assessing risks and applying a risk-based approach)
Wolfsberg Group, Guidance on a Risk Based Approach for Managing Money Laundering Risks (2006)

indicators.name: Rapid in-and-out movement of funds
indicators.desc: Funds received into an account are forwarded onward within a very short period, often in near-equal amounts and leaving minimal balance.
indicators.ctx: Funds are received and moved on within a short period, leaving little residual balance.
indicators.fp: Payment processors, escrow and pass-through business accounts behave this way legitimately.

indicators.name: No apparent economic or lawful rationale
indicators.canon: No apparent economic or lawful rationale
indicators.desc: Transactions lack commercial logic given the customer's business or relationship.
indicators.ctx: Transactions lack commercial logic given the customer's business or relationship.
indicators.fp: Atypical but genuine one-off deals occur.

indicators.name: Activity inconsistent with customer profile
indicators.desc: Transactions or withdrawals are uncharacteristic of, or inconsistent with, the customer's known profile, income or expected activity.
indicators.ctx: Turnover, counterparties or products exceed or depart from expected behaviour.
indicators.fp: Life events and growth change behaviour.

indicators.name: Dormant account suddenly reactivated
indicators.canon: Dormant account suddenly reactivated or high-velocity activity
indicators.desc: A dormant or low-activity account suddenly shows high-velocity inflows and outflows.
indicators.ctx: Long-inactive account receives sudden large or high-velocity activity.
indicators.fp: Seasonal use and inheritance can reactivate accounts.

indicators.name: Repeated round-value transactions
indicators.desc: Transactions are repeatedly in round or unusually uniform amounts that do not fit the stated purpose.
indicators.ctx: Frequent round-sum amounts without related invoices or obligations.
indicators.fp: Rent, salaries and gifts often use round numbers.

indicators.name: Frequent third-party payments
indicators.canon: Payments from or to unrelated third parties
indicators.desc: Funds are paid or received, or instructions are given to pay, through parties with no evident link to the customer, contract, debt or insured interest. Includes third-party cheques, loan repayments, premiums, gaming funds and goods payments not matching the documentation.
indicators.ctx: Funds regularly sent or received from parties with no clear link to the customer.
indicators.fp: Family support, agents and platforms use third parties.

indicators.name: Structuring below reporting or monitoring thresholds
indicators.canon: Cash deposits just below reporting or identification threshold
indicators.desc: Repeated cash deposits kept just under a reporting, identification or monitoring threshold.
indicators.ctx: Series of transactions sized to remain just below limits.
indicators.fp: Habitual amounts may coincide with limits.

indicators.name: Sudden large increase in transaction volume
indicators.canon: Sudden large increase in transaction volume
indicators.desc: Transaction volume or value rises abruptly well beyond historical levels, including through a respondent or reactivated account.
indicators.ctx: Abrupt step change in value or count without explanation.

indicators.name: Circular or back-to-back flows
indicators.canon: Circular or round-trip flows among related parties
indicators.desc: Funds or goods-linked payments loop back to the originator or between related counterparties, or are traded back and forth.
indicators.ctx: Funds return to origin or pass through linked parties in loops.

indicators.name: Use of multiple accounts to move funds
indicators.canon: Use of multiple accounts to move funds
indicators.desc: Customer spreads activity across many accounts, products or institutions.
indicators.ctx: Customer spreads activity across many accounts, products or institutions.

indicators.name: Transactions with high-risk counterparties
indicators.canon: Adverse media or intelligence linking counterparties to criminal activity
indicators.desc: Counterparties, suppliers, respondents or controllers appear in adverse media, law-enforcement notices or intelligence connected to financial crime, abuse, forced labour or organised crime.
indicators.ctx: Payments to or from parties linked to adverse media, sanctions or higher-risk sectors.
